sources.title: OpenStreetMap extracts via Overpass API
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
sources.update_frequency: Continuous community edits; extract currency depends on retrieval timestamp.
sources.attribution_text: Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under ODbL.
sources.provenance_notes: Store Overpass query, bbox, endpoint, retrieval timestamp, element id, version, changeset, and OSM timestamp. OSM edit timestamps are mapped visibility dates, not direct construction dates.
caveats: Do not present OSM edit dates as real-world opening or construction dates.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap full-history analytics via ohsome API
sources.provider: HeiGIT ohsome API using OpenStreetMap history
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0 for OSM-derived data
sources.update_frequency: Service-dependent; query metadata must record temporal filter and retrieval timestamp.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute OpenStreetMap contributors and retain ohsome query metadata.
sources.provenance_notes: Recommended source for reproducible OSM history snapshots and counts.
caveats: Historical OSM presence reflects mapper activity and source availability as well as real-world change.

sources.title: Northern Ireland planning activity statistics
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 where published as public-sector information; verify per release
sources.attribution_text: Contains public sector information from the Department for Infrastructure licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0, where applicable.
sources.provenance_notes: Use application id, decision date, category, status, source file, and retrieval date. Records show planning decisions, not construction completions.
caveats: Planning approval is not evidence that a development was built.

sources.title: Belfast City Council open and linked data
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for listed open datasets
sources.update_frequency: Dataset-specific; record modified date or page update date.
sources.attribution_text: Contains Belfast City Council open data licensed under the Open Government Licence, where stated by the dataset page.
sources.provenance_notes: Keep dataset page URL, download URL, licence text, update date, and attribution statement.
caveats: Use only non-personal datasets and preserve dataset-specific terms.

sources.title: Belfast City Council public project and facility pages
sources.licence: Web page terms; cite as evidence URL, do not redistribute page text as open data without review
sources.attribution_text: Source page: Belfast City Council. Use URL and access date for citation.
sources.provenance_notes: Use only small factual event metadata and source URLs unless dataset terms permit redistribution.
caveats: Public pages can change; record access date and avoid copying page text into artifacts.

sources.title: Translink open data feeds and files
sources.provider: Translink / Northern Ireland Transport Holding Company
sources.licence: Open Government Licence or Translink Access to Information Licence, dataset-specific
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Translink/NITHC and preserve the dataset-specific licence.
sources.provenance_notes: Record feed URL, resource date, route area, checksum, and licence.
caveats: Historical replay requires archived feed snapshots; current feeds alone are not historical evidence.

sources.title: Translink public project and station pages
sources.provider: Translink / Northern Ireland Transport Holding Company
sources.licence: Web page terms; cite as evidence URL, do not redistribute page text as open data without review
sources.attribution_text: Source page: Translink. Use URL and access date for citation.
sources.provenance_notes: Use for named station or project event citations, not as a bulk open-data feed.
caveats: Public pages can change; record access date and avoid copying page text into artifacts.

sources.title: Department for Infrastructure NI public project pages
sources.licence: Public-sector web page terms; verify OGL applicability before redistribution
sources.attribution_text: Source page: Department for Infrastructure, Northern Ireland. Use URL and access date for citation.
sources.provenance_notes: Use for project evidence URLs and dates when the page documents them.
caveats: Project pages are evidence of official statements, not a complete event register.

sources.title: OpenDataNI and Spatial NI datasets
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for many datasets; verify per resource
sources.attribution_text: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0, plus dataset-specific attribution where required.
sources.provenance_notes: Store package id, resource id, resource URL, licence, modified date, and checksum.
caveats: Spatial NI/LPS layers can carry extra terms; verify each resource before publication.

sources.title: NISRA census, population, deprivation, and geography releases
sources.provider: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for many releases; verify per dataset
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NISRA and the relevant statistical release/table.
sources.provenance_notes: Preserve table id, geography code, release date, and checksum.
caveats: Use statistics as context. Do not infer causality between events and demographic change without validated methodology.

sources.title: Ulster University public campus pages
sources.licence: Web page terms; cite as evidence URL, do not redistribute page text as open data without review
sources.attribution_text: Source page: Ulster University. Use URL and access date for citation.
sources.provenance_notes: Use for named public institutional events and keep citation URLs.
caveats: Institutional pages can change; record access date.

sources.title: Belfast public project fallback citations
sources.licence: Source-specific web terms; cite URLs only until terms are reviewed
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the named public source and preserve the evidence URL.
sources.provenance_notes: Fallback only when legacy records identify a public URL but not a normalized registry source.
caveats: Replace with a more specific source id during future curation.

sources.title: Belfast architecture and major project public pages
sources.provider: Named Belfast public, institutional, venue, and architecture sources
sources.licence: Source-specific web terms; cite URLs only until terms are reviewed
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the named publisher in each milestone event and preserve the evidence URL.
sources.provenance_notes: Curated public-source milestone layer for major named architecture and built-environment changes. Use event source_url, source_date_field, and limitations for citation.
caveats: Curated milestone layer is not a complete planning or building-control register.
Public pages can change; keep retrieval dates and avoid copying page text.

sources.title: London architecture and major project public pages
sources.provider: Named London public, institutional, venue, developer, and architecture sources
sources.licence: Source-specific web terms; cite URLs only until terms are reviewed
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the named publisher in each milestone event and preserve the evidence URL.
sources.provenance_notes: Curated public-source milestone layer for major named London architecture and built-environment changes. Use event source_url, source_date_field, and limitations for citation.
caveats: Curated milestone layer is not a complete London development register.
Public pages can change; keep retrieval dates and avoid copying page text.

sources.title: New York City architecture and major project public pages
sources.provider: Named NYC public, institutional, venue, developer, and architecture sources
sources.licence: Source-specific web terms; cite URLs only until terms are reviewed
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the named publisher in each milestone event and preserve the evidence URL.
sources.provenance_notes: Curated public-source milestone layer for major named New York City architecture and built-environment changes. Use event source_url, source_date_field, and limitations for citation.
caveats: Curated milestone layer is not a complete NYC permit, certificate-of-occupancy, landmark, or zoning ledger.
Public pages can change; keep retrieval dates and avoid copying page text.

sources.title: Greater London Authority London Datastore
sources.licence: London Datastore terms; dataset-level licence and attribution required
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the Greater London Authority and dataset publisher; state that GLA cannot warrant quality or accuracy where required.
sources.provenance_notes: Record dataset page, resource URL, modified date, licence, and checksum.
caveats: Review dataset-specific terms before publishing derived artifacts.

sources.title: Planning London Datahub
sources.provider: Greater London Authority and London Planning Authorities
sources.licence: Public access with dataset/layer-specific terms; verify before redistribution
sources.update_frequency: Daily updates during the decision process.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Greater London Authority, relevant London Planning Authority, and any dataset/layer-specific copyright notices.
sources.provenance_notes: Store application id, planning authority, validation/decision dates, API query, retrieval timestamp, and quality flags.
caveats: Applicant-supplied records can be amended during quality review; preserve update timestamps.

sources.title: Transport for London open data
sources.licence: TfL transport data terms and conditions
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Transport for London and comply with TfL transport data terms.
sources.provenance_notes: Record feed URL, endpoint, request parameters, response timestamp, and terms.
caveats: Use current feeds as current-state context unless archived snapshots are available.

sources.title: NYC Open Data portal datasets
sources.provider: City of New York agencies and partners
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; no restrictions on use according to NYC Open Data FAQ
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC Open Data and the publishing agency/dataset.
sources.provenance_notes: Record Socrata dataset id, API URL, query, publication/update metadata, and retrieval timestamp.
caveats: Check dataset metadata for update cadence, suppressed fields, and quality notes.

sources.title: NYC Department of Buildings applications and permits datasets
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; dataset-specific metadata applies
sources.update_frequency: Dataset-specific; many DOB operational datasets update frequently.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC Department of Buildings and NYC Open Data dataset metadata.
sources.provenance_notes: Record job/application id, permit id, filing date, status, address/BBL, dataset id, and retrieval timestamp.
caveats: A filing or permit is an administrative event, not evidence of construction completion.

sources.title: NYC Department of City Planning MapPLUTO
sources.licence: NYC DCP MapPLUTO terms and disclaimers; verify current release before redistribution
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC Department of City Planning and the MapPLUTO release.
sources.provenance_notes: Record release version, file URL, borough, BBL, geometry CRS, and checksum.
caveats: MapPLUTO is parcel context and carries completeness/fitness disclaimers; do not treat as an event feed.

sources.title: US Census ACS and TIGER/Line geography
sources.licence: US federal public data; cite Census Bureau tables and vintages
sources.update_frequency: Annual ACS releases; decennial census and geography vintages are release-specific.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the U.S. Census Bureau, table id, geography vintage, and release year.
sources.provenance_notes: Record API query, table id, estimate/moe fields, geography vintage, and retrieval timestamp.
caveats: Use as context and denominators; preserve margins of error for ACS estimates.

sources.title: Landsat Collection 2 archive
sources.licence: Public domain; acknowledgement requested
sources.update_frequency: Ongoing scene releases; archive is stable.
sources.attribution_text: Landsat Collection 2 imagery courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
sources.provenance_notes: Record path/row, acquisition date, processing level, scene identifier, and retrieval timestamp. PDF catalog flags Landsat as the long public-domain backbone for urban heat, surface temperature, land cover, and greenness.
caveats: 30 m multispectral resolution; pair with higher-resolution imagery for fine-grained urban detail.

sources.title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery
sources.provider: European Union Copernicus Programme / European Space Agency
sources.licence: Free, full and open access under EU Copernicus terms
sources.attribution_text: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; processed by the European Space Agency.
sources.provenance_notes: Record granule id, acquisition date, processing baseline, and cloud-mask method. PDF catalog flags Sentinel-2 as a portable cross-city layer alongside Landsat.
caveats: Sentinel-2 record begins in 2015; not usable for pre-2015 retrospectives.

sources.title: NYC Map Tiles orthophotos and aerial photo history
sources.provider: City of New York / Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications
sources.licence: Open city imagery served via NYC Map Tiles; verify per vintage
sources.update_frequency: Basemap quarterly; imagery by capture cycle.
sources.attribution_text: Imagery courtesy of the City of New York via NYC Map Tiles.
sources.provenance_notes: Record vintage year, tile template, projection, and retrieval timestamp. PDF catalog lists 1924, 1951, 1996, 2001-02 then biennial captures 2004-2022.
caveats: Tile page does not list 2024 or 2026 captures yet; treat post-2022 imagery as not officially published until verified.

sources.title: NYC planimetrics and 3D building model
sources.provider: NYC Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.update_frequency: Periodic; produced every other ortho capture.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications and NYC Open Data.
sources.provenance_notes: Planimetric extraction begins 2004; 3D building model is a 2014 snapshot per the PDF catalog.
caveats: 3D model is a single 2014 snapshot; do not treat as a continuous time series.

sources.title: PLUTO and MapPLUTO land-use lot files
sources.licence: NYC DCP MapPLUTO terms; NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC Department of City Planning and the MapPLUTO release vintage.
sources.provenance_notes: Record release version, BBL, year built, land use, lot area, FAR, and retrieval timestamp.
caveats: MapPLUTO is parcel context; pre-2010 vintage continuity was not individually verified in the PDF pass.

sources.title: NYC Digital Tax Map and tax lot polygons
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC Department of Finance and NYC Open Data dataset metadata.
sources.provenance_notes: Record tax lot, tax block, lot face id, geometry CRS, and retrieval timestamp.
caveats: DOF tax mapping reflects fiscal geography; not a planning or land-use boundary in itself.

sources.title: NYC DOB construction filings and permits (granular)
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC Department of Buildings and the relevant Socrata dataset (DOB Job Application Filings, BIS Permit Issuance, DOB NOW Build Approved Permits).
sources.provenance_notes: Three datasets: DOB Job Application Filings (filing ledger), BIS Permit Issuance (legacy), DOB NOW Build Approved Permits (current).
caveats: Filing dates are administrative events, not construction completions.

sources.title: NYC certificates of occupancy and housing delivery rollups
sources.provider: NYC Department of Buildings and NYC Department of City Planning
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.update_frequency: Ongoing for CO modules; periodic housing rollups.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC DOB and DCP for the relevant CO and Housing Database datasets.
sources.provenance_notes: BIS CO covers 2012-07-12 to March 2021; DOB NOW CO takes over after that; DCP Housing Database aggregates approved/demolished jobs.
caveats: CO issuance lags physical delivery; treat as best proxy for usable building stock change.

sources.title: NYC zoning, environmental review, and land-use documents
sources.provider: NYC Department of City Planning and NYC Mayor's Office of Environmental Coordination
sources.licence: Agency site terms; public documents may contain personal data
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC DCP and NYC MOEC (CEQR Access).
sources.provenance_notes: ZAP exposes project search; CEQR Access provides environmental review docs (records back to 1979 in CEQR project search).
caveats: Public documents may contain personal data; minimize redistribution and prefer document links.

sources.title: NYC Centerline and LION street network
sources.provider: NYC Department of City Planning and NYC DOITT
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC DCP / DOITT and NYC Open Data.
sources.provenance_notes: Centerline is the road-bed representation; LION remains the historic all-purpose street database.
caveats: Segment versioning is required to preserve historical road geometry.

sources.title: NYC DOT traffic volume and vehicle classification counts
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC DOT and NYC Open Data.
sources.provenance_notes: Historical traffic volume counts and vehicle classification counts (2011-2025 in the cited dataset).
caveats: Periodic surveys, not continuous sensors; do not assume full station continuity.

sources.title: MTA developer feeds and Bus Time APIs
sources.licence: MTA developer terms
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the Metropolitan Transportation Authority and developer terms.
sources.provenance_notes: GTFS, GTFS-RT protobuf, SIRI JSON/XML and REST endpoints across MTA services and Bus Time.
caveats: Live feeds reflect operating state; use archived snapshots for retrospective analysis.

sources.title: MTA subway ridership, turnstiles, and station access
sources.provider: Metropolitan Transportation Authority via Open NY
sources.licence: Open NY terms
sources.update_frequency: Daily to hourly depending on feed.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute MTA via Open NY and the relevant ridership / station dataset.
sources.provenance_notes: Annual turnstile usage 2015-2022; hourly subway ridership 2020-2024 and beginning-2025 datasets; daily 2020-2025; OD estimates and entrances/exits dataset.
caveats: 2020 pandemic disruption requires special-context caveats for ridership deltas.

sources.title: NYC 311 complaints and service requests
sources.licence: NYC Open Data; no general restrictions on use, privacy care required
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC 311 and NYC Open Data.
sources.provenance_notes: Point/address, complaint type, and timestamp across all 311 service requests since 2010.
caveats: Combining complaint text, addresses, and sensitive topics carries privacy and defamation risk; minimize personal-text display.

sources.title: LEHD/LODES, ACS, and decennial Census for NYC
sources.licence: US federal public domain; preserve table id and vintage
sources.attribution_text: Attribute U.S. Census Bureau and preserve table id, geography vintage, and margins of error for ACS estimates.
sources.provenance_notes: LODES reaches 2002-2022; ACS 1-year 2005-2024; ACS 5-year 2009-2024; decennial APIs cover 2000, 2010, 2020.
caveats: Annual releases lag publication time; treat 2025-2026 estimates as not yet published unless verified.

sources.title: NYC DOF sales, valuations, and rent context
sources.provider: NYC Department of Finance and partners (HVS, RGB)
sources.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; survey/report products carry their own usage conventions
sources.attribution_text: Attribute NYC DOF and the relevant sales/valuation dataset; for HVS and RGB attribute the survey publisher.
sources.provenance_notes: Annualized citywide sales updates; property valuation and assessment is annual; NYC HVS is triennial; RGB research extends to the 1990s.
caveats: NYC rent context relies on survey/report families rather than a single transactional feed.

sources.title: Planning London Datahub core platform
sources.provider: Greater London Authority and London Planning Authorities
sources.licence: Public portal; respect dataset-level terms
sources.attribution_text: Attribute GLA and the relevant London Planning Authority.
sources.provenance_notes: Live citywide planning permissions with progress data; starts and completions supplied annually by boroughs.
caveats: Inbound borough data are not fully quality-checked at receipt per dashboard notes.

sources.title: Planning London Datahub guest API and schema
sources.licence: Publicly documented guest API; header required
sources.attribution_text: Attribute the GLA Planning London Datahub guest API.
sources.provenance_notes: Read-only Elasticsearch-style search endpoint; record query DSL, retrieval timestamp, and response schema version.
caveats: Guest API quotas and schemas can change; record API connection technical documentation version.

sources.title: London residential approvals, starts, completions dashboards
sources.licence: London Datastore package-level terms
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Greater London Authority and the relevant London Datastore package.
sources.provenance_notes: Three dashboards derived from PLD: approvals, starts, and completions, plus periodic downloadable resources.
caveats: Dashboard notes warn that inbound borough data are not fully quality-checked at receipt.

sources.title: London Development Database archive and PlanApps comments
sources.provider: Greater London Authority and London boroughs
sources.licence: London Datastore terms; site-specific planning terms
sources.update_frequency: LDD archived; PlanApps current for live applications.
sources.attribution_text: Attribute GLA and the relevant borough planning authority.
sources.provenance_notes: LDD is archived but useful historically; PlanApps supports decisions back to 2012 and accepts public comments.
caveats: Planning comments may contain personal data or allegations; minimize personal-text display.

sources.title: OS Open Roads, USRN, UPRN, OpenMap Local, Open Zoomstack
sources.licence: Open Government Licence for OS OpenData products
sources.attribution_text: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right; reuse under the Open Government Licence.
sources.provenance_notes: Five OS open layers: Open Roads, Open USRN, Open UPRN, OpenMap Local, Open Zoomstack.
caveats: These are current open national layers, not historical time series themselves; pair with snapshots for change detection.

sources.title: OS 3D Mesh and London Building Stock Model v2
sources.provider: Ordnance Survey and Greater London Authority
sources.licence: OS 3D Mesh beta access; LBSM v2 GLA analytical model with site-specific terms
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Ordnance Survey for 3D Mesh and Greater London Authority for London Building Stock Model v2.
sources.provenance_notes: OS 3D Mesh launched as beta in 2025; LBSM v2 builds on a 2017 predecessor and is updated in-house at GLA.
caveats: Beta access and analytical model terms are not equivalent to unrestricted open data.

sources.title: Historic England aerial archive and Environment Agency vertical aerials
sources.licence: Mixed: Historic England image rights vary per image; Environment Agency data are official open-government-style datasets
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Historic England Aerial Photo Explorer and Environment Agency vertical aerials.
sources.provenance_notes: Historic England exposes 540,000+ digitized photos from a much larger archive; Environment Agency vertical aerials are official airborne mapping data.
caveats: OS MasterMap Imagery is authoritative but licensed, not open; verify image-level rights before redistribution.

sources.title: DfT road traffic statistics for London
sources.licence: Open Government Licence for published statistics
sources.attribution_text: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
sources.provenance_notes: London region count points and raw counts in CSV and JSON; quality note distinguishes Counted from Estimated methods.
caveats: Always preserve estimation method and upweight directly counted observations.

sources.title: TfL Unified API, accessibility, demand, and cycle hire
sources.licence: TfL transport data terms based on OGL with amendments
sources.attribution_text: Powered by TfL Open Data; contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right where applicable.
sources.provenance_notes: Unified API covers lines, routes, stops, BikePoint, occupancy; PTAL and station topology available; cycle hire counts run from 30 July 2010 launch through March 2026.
caveats: Check caching, branding, and commercial republication rules for each TfL endpoint.

sources.title: Nomis, BRES, ONS population and GLA borough jobs
sources.provider: Office for National Statistics and Greater London Authority
sources.licence: Open Government Licence with statistical disclosure controls where applicable
sources.update_frequency: Annual or quarterly depending on family.
sources.attribution_text: Contains National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right; data via Nomis where applicable.
sources.provenance_notes: Nomis exposes ONS labour market and census outputs; BRES is the official employment estimate; ONS mid-year population estimates 2011-2024 with older series; 2001 Census via ONS; GLA borough-by-sector jobs spans 1971-2023.
caveats: Annual releases lag publication; treat 2025-2026 as not yet published unless verified.

sources.title: HM Land Registry Price Paid, UK HPI, and VOA private rents
sources.provider: HM Land Registry, ONS and Valuation Office Agency
sources.licence: Official government terms; Price Paid permitted-use guidance applies
sources.attribution_text: Contains HM Land Registry data © Crown copyright and database right; Price Paid Data and UK HPI under Open Government Licence v3.0.
sources.provenance_notes: Price Paid Data is monthly from 1995 with yearly files; UK HPI is monthly and linked-data enabled; VOA private rents are biannual and changed cadence after 2013.
caveats: Price Paid permitted-use guidance restricts certain redistribution patterns; verify before publishing derived artifacts.

sources.title: Talk London, Annual London Survey, and consultations
sources.licence: Mixed package and site terms
sources.attribution_text: Attribute Greater London Authority and the relevant survey or consultation.
sources.provenance_notes: Annual London Survey toplines 2000-2011 (no 2008 survey); from 2014 delivered by Talk London (launched 2012). Mayoral planning consultations and police dashboards downloadable through London Datastore.
caveats: No citywide 311-style operational complaint ledger; treat as opinion and consultation evidence rather than service-request exhaust.
